n: CMU Robotics Academy Certified K-12 Robotics Programs and online teacher training
t: Certified K-12 robotics programs and online teacher training from Carnegie Mellon.
steps: Find the Certified K-12 Robotics Programs page on the Carnegie Mellon Robotics Academy site.
Choose the robot platform your school owns.
Register through the CS2N digital store or by purchase order.
Choose a live or self-paced course.
Gather the robot hardware before the first session.
